name: Summer Youth Employment Program
city: Seattle, WA (serves SW and SE Seattle and South King County)
what_you_do: A 6-week paid summer internship for 20 teens. Interns explore career paths, take field trips, hear guest speakers and work on personal growth.
grades: Entering 9th grade (fall 2026) through high school seniors (Class of 2030)
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18. Grades: entering 9th grade (fall 2026) through high school seniors. Selected teens must give a copy of a Social Security card and complete a W-9.
pay_detail: Stipend paid after successful completion. 2026 page does not state the amount (older SafeFutures pages said $1,000).
duration: 6 weeks, July 2 to Aug 14 in 2026, Monday to Thursday, 12 pm to 6 pm
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened in April 2026. Close date not stated. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form linked on the SafeFutures internship page. If you are picked, you have 2 business days to say yes.
notes: Very competitive: the page accepts 20 applicants. The page URL says 2023 but the content is the 2026 program. The 2026 page states no stipend amount. Work permit rule not stated.
